notes: Cross-verse consistency with the chapter's four other rule 30 fusions. JER.3.3 marked אִשָּׁה unrepresented beside זוֹנָה -> 'harlot's', while JER.3.1, 3.6, 3.10 and 3.11 all fuse two morphemes rendered by one English word into a single noncompositional unit. Rule 30 rules against the split shape directly, and states that what the second morpheme is tagged does not matter. s010 and s011 are merged into one noncompositional unit headed on זוֹנָה, the morpheme carrying the lexeme, and on the English anchor 'harlot's'. No other unit, edge or head changes; the verse now has 15 units.
